data.reasoning: This is a UI setting state icon (stopwatch with 'A' for Automatic Timer / Auto-off), not an everyday object or activity. In a task list it is easily confused with a regular stopwatch/timer or an alarm icon, and almost any real task would be better served by a plain timer or the icon of the appliance being configured.
